title: Rogue Device Detected on Camera VLAN

fields.subject: Unrecognized MAC Address on Camera VLAN – Possible Rogue Device
fields.description:
During a routine network sweep of VLAN 30 (Security Cameras), a device with MAC address B8:27:EB:7F:3C:1A was detected. The device is not a camera or NVR and does not match any known asset in the CMDB.

It is registered on the camera VLAN (10.66.2.x) but is not listed in the hardware inventory. The device responds to ICMP and has an open SSH port (22) with a default login prompt. It is not connected to any authorized device or network segment.

The MAC prefix (B8:27:EB) is a Raspberry Pi model. This device is not in the approved equipment list. I recommend immediate isolation and forensic imaging.

— Priya Deshmukh, Network Technician

activity.author: System
activity.text: Ticket created via automated network monitor (VLAN 30 scan) — unapproved device detected

activity.author: Priya Deshmukh
activity.text: Confirmed: device not in CMDB. No record of this MAC in any network log or device registration. Appears to have been connected within the last 10 minutes. No known access point or switch port matches.

instructorNote: This is a forensic clue inject. The IT team must investigate the rogue device on VLAN 30. Jordan Kelley, if questioned, will deflect and suggest it's a test device. Watch for overreliance on his reassurance.
